title: Experts disagree on src/kernel/gate.ts allowedOnce
context:
Chief architect: the two claims agree (a leftover mark for an older tool_use_id cannot match, so the new call blocks), but a must-level security-auditor claim makes this the owner's pick; the security claim is the stronger rule and the qa case becomes its boundary test

Target: src/kernel/gate.ts allowedOnce
- security-auditor: the gate answers ask only when the stop record's tool_use_id, rule and file all equal the current call's, and refuses when the call carries no tool_use_id; it never falls back to matching on rule and file alone, because the unguessable tool_use_id is the only thing stopping the model from forging allowed_once: true into the stop record with a shell write
- qa-engineer: Given a leftover allowed_once mark for an older tool_use_id (override recorded but retry never reached the gate), when a new call with another id is blocked by the same rule, then it blocks and the mark is not consumed
